description: Returns loans in public CMBS trusts that match your filters, largest balance first unless sorted, with the total match count and total balance. Use it to find a loan or property by name, address, city or ZIP, or to screen by status, type, state, metro, tenant, maturity, balance, coverage, occupancy, rate, vintage, servicer, originator or trust. All filters are optional and combine; no match returns an empty list and a total of 0. Use get_loan for one loan's full record and tenant_exposure to rank tenants.

built_after.description: Property built in or after this year, e.g. 2016; loans with one property only

built_before.description: Property built in or before this year

cbsa.description: Census CBSA metro code, e.g. 35620 for New York

city.description: Whole city name, optionally with state, e.g. "Houston" or "Houston, TX"

interest_only.description: How the loan pays from its terms at origination: full (interest only for the whole term), partial (for part of it), any (either) or none (amortizing)

limit.description: Results per call: up to 10 without a key, 100 with one

max_debt_yield.description: Maximum debt yield on the latest NOI, as a fraction or percent: 0.08 or 8

max_occupancy.description: Maximum latest occupancy, as a fraction or percent

max_rate.description: Maximum current interest rate, as a fraction or percent

min_debt_yield.description: Minimum debt yield on the latest NOI, as a fraction or percent: 0.1 or 10

min_occupancy.description: Minimum latest occupancy, as a fraction or percent: 0.8 or 80

min_rate.description: Minimum current interest rate, as a fraction or percent: 0.05 or 5

offset.description: For paging: without a key a search stops at the first 25 results; with a key it pages through everything

originator.description: Originator, or part of the name, e.g. "Wells Fargo"

q.description: Word starts in the property name, street address, ZIP, city, metro, state, property type or trust name, e.g. "times square", "825 Eighth Avenue" or "houston office"

special_servicer.description: Trust's special servicer: finds loans in trusts whose general special servicer is this name, or part of it, e.g. "Rialto". A given loan may be serviced by someone else

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, or several with commas between, e.g. "FL,TX"

status.description: Loan condition, or a Schedule AL status as filed: foreclosure, reo (real estate owned), forbearance or extended (a modification dated in the last 24 months)

tenant.description: A tenant named among the three largest, e.g. "Walgreens"

trust.description: Only loans in this trust, by slug, e.g. "benchmark-2018-b8"

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code of the property, e.g. "10001"

name: search_loans

advances.description: Servicer advances on the loan from the trusts' latest 10-D reports, summed across the trusts.

appraisalReduction.description: Appraisal reduction from the trusts' latest 10-D trustee reports.

balance.description: Current balance in dollars: the sum of the actual ending balances of every note of the loan in the trusts on file, including pieces read from older trusts' 10-D statements and carried notes.

carried.description: Present when the trust's latest asset file leaves the loan out while its 10-D still reports it: figures are from the last asset file that listed it, balance from the 10-D, and status fields are null.

carriedBalance.description: Dollars: the part of balance in notes the trusts' latest asset files leave out while their 10-D reports still carry them (included in balance).

cbsa.description: Census CBSA code (5 digits, as a string) for metro.

city.description: City of the first property as filed.

consolidatedStatement.description: True when a portfolio is filed on one rolled-up statement (Schedule AL code C on every property row), so dscr and noi are the whole loan's.

cumulativeAser.description: Cumulative appraisal subordinate entitlement reduction (ASER) in dollars: interest the servicer has not advanced because of the appraisal reduction, to date, summed across the trusts' 10-D reports.

debtYield.description: noi divided by balance, as a fraction of 1 rounded to 4 places (0.0768 = 7.68%).

defeased.description: True when the loan is fully defeased (every property row coded F).

delinquent.description: True when the payment status code is 1, 2, 3 or 5 (30+ days late or non-performing matured), or an older trust's statement shows REO or foreclosure.

dscr.description: Latest debt service coverage ratio on NOI as the servicer files it, a plain ratio (1.45 = 1.45x); not recomputed by cmbs.news.

dscrAsOf.description: YYYY-MM month of the report dscr comes from, present only when the latest report left DSCR blank.

dscrAtSecuritization.description: NOI debt service coverage ratio at securitization (underwritten), a plain ratio.

effectiveMaturity.description: The date the site treats as the loan's maturity, YYYY-MM-DD: the earlier of (a) maturity, or the post-modification maturity when that is later, and (b) the anticipated repayment date if any.

financialsThrough.description: End date of the latest operating statement, YYYY-MM-DD. Single-property loans (or a consolidated statement) only.

foreclosureDate.description: Foreclosure date printed in a trust's 10-D Delinquency Loan Detail (latest across the trusts), YYYY-MM-DD. Present only when printed.

guarantorFlagAsOfIssuance.description: Paid plans: a sentence quoted from a prospectus that says the loan has no (separate) guarantor or that limits the guaranty, shown so the name is never read without it.

guarantorOrSponsorAsOfIssuance.description: Paid plans: the guarantor and sponsor names the loan's prospectuses print, each once, joined with '; '. As of issuance; it does not update if the borrower changes.

guarantorOrSponsorOnFile.description: Free plan: true when cmbs.news holds at least one guarantor or sponsor name for this loan from its prospectus, false when it holds none.

largestLeaseEnds.description: Lease expiration date of the largest tenant, YYYY-MM-DD. Null when not filed or multi-property.

largestTenants.description: Names of up to three largest tenants as filed, largest first ('vacant' dropped).

latestValuation.description: Most recent valuation of the property in dollars, as filed; it can still be the securitization appraisal.

latestValuationSource.description: Schedule AL mostRecentValuationSourceCode for latestValuation. Values: 98 = Other; MAI = Certified MAI appraisal; Non-MAI = Non-certified MAI appraisal; BPO = Broker price opinion; MS = Master servicer estimate; SS = Special servicer estimate.

lienPosition.description: Schedule AL lienPositionSecuritizationCode when it is not a first lien. Values: 2 = Secondary; 3 = Tertiary, etc.; 98 = Other; 99 = Unknown.

maturity.description: Maturity date as the lead note files it (Schedule AL maturityDate), YYYY-MM-DD. Not adjusted for a modification or an anticipated repayment date; trusts holding one loan can file different dates.

metro.description: Census CBSA title of the first property's ZIP (metropolitan areas only).

modificationCode.description: Schedule AL modificationCode of the note with the newest modification date. Values: 1 = Maturity Date Extension; 2 = Amortization Change; 3 = Principal Write-off; 5 = Temporary Rate Reduction; 6 = Capitalization on Interest; 7 = Capitalization on Taxes; 8 = Combination; 10 = Forbearance; 98 = Other.

modificationDate.description: Date of the last modification from the same note as modificationCode, YYYY-MM-DD.

modified.description: True when the filing's modifiedIndicator is true (the loan has been modified at some point).

name.description: Property name as the lead note's filing gives it (first property of a portfolio), title-cased; for an older trust's portfolio, the prospectus loan name.

noi.description: Latest net operating income in dollars on a full-year basis (NOI, not net cash flow): the filed mostRecentNetOperatingIncomeAmount, scaled to a year only when statementBasis is annualized; summed...

noiAsFiled.description: NOI in dollars exactly as filed for statementMonths months, given only when statementBasis is partial, season or stale (then noi is null).

noiAtSecuritization.description: Underwritten NOI at securitization in dollars per year, summed across the loan's properties.

nonRecoverable.description: Dollar amount the trusts' 10-D reports list as non-recoverable advances / workout-delayed reimbursement amounts (the report's NRA/WODRA column), summed across trusts.

notes.description: The loan's pieces: one entry per note in a trust on file, largest balance first.

occupancy.description: Latest physical occupancy as a fraction of 1 (0.94 = 94%).

occupancyAsOf.description: YYYY-MM month of the report occupancy comes from, present only when the latest report left occupancy blank.

occupancyAtSecuritization.description: Physical occupancy at securitization as a fraction of 1.

olderTrust.description: Present when every note of the loan is in older trusts (issued before late 2016) that file no ABS-EE: figures are from the 10-D statement and the prospectus.

olderTrustsBalance.description: Dollars of balance that sit in older trusts read from 10-D statements, when the loan also has notes on current asset files.

onWatchSince.description: YYYY-MM: first month of the unbroken run of monthly reports, within the 12-month history, in which the loan was with the special servicer, delinquent (status 1, 2, 3, 5) or under 1.00x DSCR. Null...

originalBalance.description: Original amount in dollars: sum of the notes' originalLoanAmount for the same notes as balance (a note filing a wrong original amount takes its current balance).

originalRate.description: Interest rate at origination (originalInterestRatePercentage of the lead note), as a fraction of 1.

originated.description: Origination date, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the filing leaves it out.

otherAdvances.description: Other advances outstanding as Schedule AL files them, summed across the loan's notes on current asset files.

paymentStatus.description: Plain-English payment status for the latest report: the label of paymentStatusCode; on an older trust's loan with no code printed it can instead read 'Real estate owned by the trust (REO)' or 'In...

paymentStatusCode.description: Schedule AL paymentStatusLoanCode for the latest report (worst across the loan's notes that month when the lead note leaves it blank). Values: 0 = Current; 1 = 30-59 days delinquent; 2 = 60-89 days delinquent; 3 = 90+ days delinquent; 4 = Performing matured balloon; 5 = Non performing matured balloon; A = Payment not received but still in grace period or not yet due; B = Late payment but less than 30 days delinquent.

properties.description: Count of properties securing the loan (the larger of the filed NumberProperties and the property rows filed).

propertiesInForeclosure.description: Count of the loan's property rows coded in foreclosure (propertyStatusCode 1) on the latest report; 0 when none.

propertiesReo.description: Count of the loan's property rows coded REO (propertyStatusCode 2) on the latest report; 0 when none.

rate.description: Current interest rate for the reporting period (reportPeriodInterestRatePercentage of the lead note), as a fraction of 1 (0.0475 = 4.75%).

realizedLoss.description: Realized loss to the trusts in dollars (realizedLossToTrustAmount summed across the loan's notes).

reoDate.description: REO date printed in a trust's 10-D Delinquency Loan Detail (latest across the trusts), YYYY-MM-DD. Present only when printed.

reportingPeriod.description: Reporting period end date of the lead note's latest report (an older trust: the 10-D's determination date), YYYY-MM-DD. The date the loan-level figures describe.

servicerComment.description: Facts drawn from the special servicer's comment on the loan in a trust's latest 10-D report (the longest comment among the loan's trusts).

slug.description: The loan's page slug and API key (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

specialServicer.description: Name of the special servicer from the trust's 10-D report.

specialServicerTransfer.description: Most recent date the loan transferred to the special servicer, YYYY-MM-DD. Shown only while withSpecialServicer is true; otherwise null.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code of the first property; null when the filed code is not one (e.g.

statementBasis.description: How the latest statement reads when its dates are not a whole year.

statementDebtServiceMonths.description: Count of months of payments the statement's filed debt service covers, given only when a part-year statement's debt service and revenue sit on different bases (so the filed dscr mixes the two and no...

statementMonths.description: Length of the latest statement in months (days/30.44, rounded), given only when statementBasis is set.

tenantRank.description: Where the tenant ranks among the property's largest tenants on that loan: 1, 2 or 3 (1 is the largest).

termsAtIssuance.description: The loan's terms at issuance, read from Annex A of the final prospectus (Form 424B) of each trust holding a piece of it, and shown only after the row was checked against the trust's own loan-level...

title.description: Display name, unique across the site: name, plus the city, maturity month or trust short name when needed; a portfolio may read 'X and N other properties'.

type.description: Property type group, from the Schedule AL property type code of the properties (most common one; a hotel filed as healthcare is lodging).

valueAtSecuritization.description: Appraised value at securitization in dollars, summed across the loan's properties.

watchFlags.description: cmbs.news's own screen flags computed from the latest filing (not the servicer's CREFC watchlist).

whatChanged.description: Pro and Team only: what the newest month of trustee reports on file changed for this loan (month, comparedWith, facts; no comment, which is in the /servicer answer).

withSpecialServicer.description: True when the latest report shows a special servicer transfer date with no later return-to-master date (or, on an older trust, the loan is on the statement's specially serviced list).

workoutStrategy.description: The special servicer's workout strategy as a label (not a code), from Schedule AL workoutStrategyCode on the latest report.

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation searchLoans). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: Data date of the loan database (latest reporting-period end across all notes), YYYY-MM-DD.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

capped.description: True, present only when more matches exist but the plan's paging reach stops here.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

limit.description: Page size applied (count of rows asked for, after plan caps).

next.description: Offset to pass for the next page; null when there is none or the plan's paging reach is hit.

noCoverage.description: Count of loans that match every filter other than min_dscr/max_dscr and report no DSCR.

noCoverageLeftOut.description: True when a DSCR filter was sent, so the noCoverage loans are excluded from total and results; false when they are included.

note.description: Present with capped: sentence saying where paging stops on this plan.

offset.description: Row offset of this page (0-based), as applied.

total.description: Count of loans matching every filter (before paging).

totalBalance.description: Sum in dollars of balance over all matching loans.
